Score Scan Reader: playback samples (assets/gm-*.json)

The instrument samples used by the score player are a sparse subset (every third
semitone) of the MP3 renders of the Fluid (R3) General MIDI SoundFont published in
gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts (https://github.com/gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts, folder
FluidR3_GM), unmodified apart from the selection of notes and repackaging as JSON
(base64 MP3, one file per instrument, written by mvp/tools/soundfont.mjs).

  gm-piano.json     acoustic_grand_piano  (GM 1)
  gm-organ.json     church_organ          (GM 20)
  gm-choir.json     choir_aahs            (GM 53)
  gm-oohs.json      voice_oohs            (GM 54)
  gm-strings.json   string_ensemble_1     (GM 49)
  gm-flute.json     flute                 (GM 74)
  gm-clarinet.json  clarinet              (GM 72)
  gm-brass.json     trumpet               (GM 57)
